prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: portrait 4:5 fragrance catalogue image for the YAT.LIFESTYLE website, compose for 1024 by 1280 pixels.
Input images: Image 1 (IMG_7733.PNG) is the PRIMARY real product reference: preserve the actual tall slim bottle's rectangular faceted glass geometry and printed identity. Image 2 is a SECONDARY dimension guide only, not a style reference; use approximately 120–126 mm total height and 17–18 mm width, an approximately 1:7 width-to-height silhouette. Do not copy dimensional labels or the three-bottle layout.
Subject: ONE upright transparent 10 mL rectangular travel perfume bottle, centered. Thick clear glass base, transparent elongated inner reservoir and slender visible dip tube. The exact vertical black sans-serif bottle print reads "YAT.LIFESTYLE", spelled Y A T . L I F E S T Y L E. Print runs along the long bottle axis on the front, matching the real reference. No other bottle text or fragrance name.
Composition/framing: whole bottle entirely visible, occupies approximately 62% of the portrait frame height; centered with generous breathing room, front-facing with a slight natural three-quarter facet visible. Tiny foreground accents never overlap the vertical print. Minimal selective depth of field, atmospheric softly blurred background, bottle and print sharply resolved.
Materials/textures: real transparent glass, physically credible reflections and refracted dip tube, polished metal, matte warm studio surface, natural delicate botanical texture.
Constraints: faithful travel-bottle size and slimness; one single bottle only; no wide perfume flacon, no round body, no cap detached, no floating objects, no invented label, no box, no diagrams, no dimensional annotations, no extra brand, no watermark, no typography anywhere except the exact bottle print. Props are conceptual scent accords, not raw ingredient claims. Output one portrait 4:5 photorealistic image.
Primary request: an exceptionally realistic luxury studio still life for Quiet, a green-tea and citrus perfume accord.
Cap: glossy BLACK cylindrical cap occupying approximately the upper quarter of total bottle height. Reflective black lacquer finish matching the black-capped real bottle reference, with controlled pale edge highlights.
Scene/backdrop: warm ivory and pale taupe studio surface and atmospheric backdrop. One small green tea sprig near the foot of the bottle, a single slender citrus-peel curl and tiny pale citrus wedge low at the frame edge. A plain low tea cup with pale green tea is softly blurred far behind, barely suggested. Restrained props and quiet negative space.
Lighting/mood: dramatic but luminous filtered late-morning studio daylight, subtle leaf-shadow impression in the distant ivory background, clear-glass edge reflections, gentle directional shadow. Warm airy background, not a dark or black scene.
